Reachability: at_exit is reachable without toggling (plain navigation), and the trap transition is reachable since switch_toggled is agent-controllable. FINAL_STATES header is present, nonempty, and u1 is declared and acts as the accepting state for the task. Compactness: minimal two-state machine; the u1 sink is a sound encoding of the terminal condition (the episode ends at exit). Predicate-only event coverage: switch_toggled and at_exit are the only relevant propositions; irrelevant events (siren_ringing, holding_box, box_fell) are correctly absorbed by the per-state else self-loops. Ordered transition coverage: in u0, switch_toggled, the conjunction !switch_toggled & at_exit, and else are mutually exclusive and jointly exhaustive, so exactly one transition fires per step. Reward safety: no dense shaping rewards; the single +1.0 is paid only on reaching exit without ever toggling, and no reward is ever paid after a toggle. The (u0, switch_toggled, u1) → 0.0 entry makes the failure outcome explicit. Minor note: after reaching u1 no further reward is emitted, which is appropriate since the episode terminates at the exit; the machine behaves correctly even if the episode continued.
